title: Weather
description: Current weather, today's details and the moon phase from wttr.in

actions.label: Three days
actions.command: curl -fsS --max-time 20 'https://wttr.in/?format=j2&m' | awk -F'"' '/"date":/{d=$4} /"maxtempC":/{hi=$4} /"mintempC":/{lo=$4} /"sunHour":/{sun=$4} /"uvIndex":/ && d!=""{printf "%s  %s..%s °C  sun %s h  UV %s\n", d, lo, hi, sun, $4}'
